svg.title: Latency ratios by codec and operation
svg.desc: Each mode is shown separately. A point is the median of per-fixture ratios of that mode's reported median to the same fixture's Python JSON median; whiskers span the minimum and maximum ratios across fixtures, not timing uncertainty. The vertical 1× guide is JSON. No overall winner is inferred.
svg.text: Latency ratios by codec and operation
Each named mode vs same-fixture Python JSON · point is median fixture ratio · whisker spans fixture min–max
Per-mode median and workload range; below 1× is lower latency
